name: drqv2-residual-options-pilot-v2
status: bounded second attempt; same consumed development screen; not confirmation or promotion

derived_from.feedback: The v1 option policy matched the frozen driver's 5/32 finishes but had 4 paired wins, 24 ties, 4 losses, lower mean progress (0.570 vs 0.685), and a 0.742 mean intervention fraction. Keep the five-option action set and duration unchanged; gate interventions using one Q-margin parameter calibrated from v1 training replay only.

environment.observation: official four-frame float32 grayscale CHW 84x84 in [0,1]
environment.reward: raw CarEnvironment reward; no shaping, normalization, or collision penalty
environment.action: native symmetric [-1,1]^3; ActionAdapter maps to official [steer,gas,brake] exactly once

base_driver.use: same frozen inference-only driver as v1; inherited training cost is not a matched new training comparison

training.previously_used_for_feedback: v1 option Q checkpoint and its replay; v2 Q head initializes from scratch, no v1 weights or optimizer are reused

intervention_margin_calibration.purpose: reduce intervention frequency; this is a declared development feedback response, not an optimal threshold

training.checkpoint: save after the fixed decision budget; discard an incomplete final option transition

development_screen.role: same previously consumed development/tuning cells as v1; explicitly not fresh; no confirmation, blind, official, or generalization claim
development_screen.prior_usage_audit: Intentionally reused only for iterative development feedback. The v1 protocol and evaluation result record their prior use.
development_screen.comparison: same frozen DrQ driver and v2 option policy on identical cells; also retain v1 result as a development reference, not an independent arm
development_screen.primary_metric: integer finish count; per-cell paired changes versus the frozen driver
development_screen.selection_rule: Development feedback only. A nonzero candidate finish and no fewer finishes than the base are a pilot continuation signal, not confirmation or promotion.

prohibitions: Do not use any reserved blind cell.
Do not call the reused development cells fresh.
Do not claim official HAIC score, model confirmation, or model promotion.
This is the single allowed feedback-driven second training attempt; do not start a third attempt from these results.
Do not modify DreamerV3 files or protected environment, native DrQ trainer, submission agent, evaluator, or packager files for this experiment.
Do not run an unbounded training/evaluation loop.
